blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: This paper presents BanglaTurn, a corpus for end-of-turn detection in Bangla conversational speech, and a model trained on it. The corpus holds 35,374 samples of 3 to 15 s of podcast speech, labelled for turn state by combining speaker diarization with an LLM pass, with every label then checked by a human annotator. The model pairs a Whisper encoder with task-specific classification heads. On a class-balanced test set drawn from a held-out podcast, it reaches 84.33% accuracy (95% CI 80.3 to 88.1) against 69.28% for the Smart-Turn v3 baseline, and lowers the false negative rate from 51.57% to 7.55% at the cost of a higher false positive rate. We report what encoder layer fine-tuning, multi-scale pooling and INT8 quantization each contribute, and latency stays within 165 to 191 ms end to end on CPU.
blocks.zh: 本文介绍BanglaTurn(孟加拉语: Bang  Bang),是孟加拉语对话演说中进行终极检测的教程,也是接受过相关培训的模特. 书目中标有35 374份播客3至15次演讲的样本,标注为转弯状态,将扬声器对称化与LLM通行证相结合,每个标签都由人名注释员检查。 模型将一个Whisper编码器配以任务特定分类头. 在从停播播客抽取的分类平衡测试中,Smart-Turn v3基线的精度达到84.33%(95%CI 80.3至88.1),而为69.28%,以较高的假正率将假负率从51.57%降至7.55%。 我们报告编码器层的微调,多尺度的集合和INT8的量化 每一个贡献, 静态停留在165到191 ms以 CPU结束。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Turn-taking governs how speakers coordinate the exchange of speaking turns [ 1 ] . Detecting when a speaker has finished, the task of end-of-turn detection, matters for conversational AI systems [ 2 ] : get it wrong and the system either cuts the user off or leaves an awkward gap, and users notice both in voice assistants and spoken dialogue applications. We use turn detection as shorthand for this task throughout.
blocks.zh: 轮到发言决定发言者如何协调交流。 侦测发言者完成后,回合终期侦测任务,对话AI系统的事项[2]:弄错了,系统要么切断用户,要么留下尴尬的缺口,用户在语音助理和口语对话应用程序中都会注意到. 我们用转弯检测来完成这项任务。

blocks.en: Early systems relied on silence thresholds [ 3 ] , which cannot separate a genuine turn ending from a pause in the middle of an utterance. Later work modelled acoustic and prosodic cues with neural networks [ 4 , 5 ] , and self-supervised representations from Wav2Vec 2.0 [ 6 ] , HuBERT [ 7 ] and Whisper [ 8 ] made transfer learning practical for the task. Low-resource languages have seen little of this progress. Bangla has more than 230 million speakers but no dedicated turn detection dataset, and multilingual models such as Smart-Turn v3 do poorly on it because Bangla conversational speech is thinly represented in their training data.
blocks.zh: 早期的系统依赖于沉默阈值[3],它不能将真正的转折结束与在话语中间的暂停分开. 之后的作品以神经网络[4,5]模拟声学和亲声提示,以及Wav2Vec 2.0 [6],HuBERT [7]和Whisper [8]的自我监督的表示,使得转移学习对任务实用. 低资源语言几乎没有取得这种进展。 孟加拉语有超过2.3亿的演讲者,但没有专门的转弯检测数据集,而Smart-Turn v3等多语种模型在其中表现不佳,因为孟加拉语对话语在其培训数据中鲜有体现.

blocks.en: This paper makes two contributions. The first is BanglaTurn, a Bangla turn detection corpus of 35,374 annotated samples. The second is a Whisper encoder-based model that reaches 84.33% accuracy, 15 points above the baseline, at speeds usable in a live system.
blocks.zh: 本文提出了两项意见。 第一种是孟加拉图尔(BanglaTurn),是35 374个注解样品的孟加拉转弯探测器。 第二种是Whisper编码器基型,精度达到84.33%,比基线高出15点,速度可用于活系统.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Our proposed model architecture with Whisper-tiny encoder finetuned in Bangla, multi-scale pooling and a classifier.
blocks.zh: 图1:我们提出的使用Whisper-tiny编码器在孟加拉语中微调的模型架构,多尺度集合和一个分类器.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Turn detection systems
blocks.zh: 2.1 转动探测系统

blocks.en: Early turn detection systems combined silence thresholds with prosodic features such as pitch contours and energy patterns [ 3 , 9 ] . Statistical models (HMMs, CRFs) then captured temporal dependencies across acoustic and linguistic features. Neural approaches followed, first with continuous LSTM-based prediction [ 4 ] , then with models that fused acoustic, prosodic and lexical cues [ 5 ] . More recently, TurnGPT [ 10 ] predicts turn-taking events from text using language-model pretraining, while Voice Activity Projection [ 11 ] learns them from self-supervised speech representations. Other work targets latency-aware prediction for real-time systems [ 12 ] and multi-party conversation [ 13 ] . Prosody remains central throughout: Ward and Vega [ 14 ] show that phrase-final words signal completion through falling pitch, lengthening and reduced intensity. Work presented at O-COCOSDA has studied the same cues from the corpus side. Furukawa et al. [ 15 ] built a multimodal corpus for modelling turn management in multi-party conversation, and Ishimoto and Enomoto [ 16 ] showed that final pitch lowering shapes how listeners perceive the end of an utterance in spontaneous Japanese.
blocks.zh: 早期转弯探测系统将静态阈值与抛子轮廓和能量模式等直径特征相结合[3,9]. 然后,统计模型(HMMs、通用报告格式)记录了不同声学和语言特征的时间依赖性。 之后是神经方法,首先是连续的基于LSTM的预测[4],然后是将声学、亲子学和语法提示融合起来的模型[5]。 最近,TurnGPT [10] 利用语言模型预训从文本中预测转机事件,而语音活动预测 [11] 从自我监督的语音表达中学习. 其他工作目标即时系统认知预测[12]和多党对话[13]. 普罗索迪在整个过程中始终处于中心位置: Ward and Vega [14] 显示短语-最终词通过下降的投球,延长和降低强度来表示完成. O-COCOSDA介绍的工作也研究了血清方面的同样线索。 富鲁卡瓦等人著. [15] 构建了多党对话中模式化转换管理模式的多模式程序,石本和江野本[16] 显示最终投球会降低听者如何看待自发日语中言论的结束.

blocks.en: 2.2 Speech representations
blocks.zh: 2.2 发言陈述

blocks.en: Self-supervised models learn transferable representations from unlabelled audio. Wav2Vec 2.0 [ 6 ] uses contrastive learning over quantized representations, HuBERT [ 7 ] predicts masked discrete hidden units, and XLSR [ 17 ] extends the approach to low-resource languages through cross-lingual pretraining.
blocks.zh: 自我监督的模型从无标签的音频中学习可转移的表示. Wav2Vec 2.0 [6] 使用对比性学习而不是量化的表示法,HuBERT [7] 预测蒙蔽的离散隐藏单位,XLSR [17] 通过跨语言的预训,将方法扩展到了低资源语言.

blocks.en: Whisper [ 8 ] is trained on 680,000 hours of weakly supervised data covering 96 languages, Bangla among them, which makes its encoder a reasonable starting point for transfer [ 18 ] . Fine-tuning the top encoder layers while freezing the lower ones trades adaptation against generalization [ 19 ] . We are not aware of work that adapts these models to turn detection in a low-resource language.
blocks.zh: Whisper [8] 接受68万小时弱监督数据的培训,涵盖96种语言,其中孟加拉语,这使得其编码器成为合理的传输起点[18]. 精细调整顶层编码器层,同时冻结下层编码器与通用化交易适应[19]. 我们不知道这些模型的改造工作是用低资源语言进行检测。

blocks.en: 2.3 Bangla speech processing
blocks.zh: 2.3 孟加拉语语音处理

blocks.en: Bangla is underrepresented relative to high-resource languages. Mozilla Common Voice [ 20 ] and Kjartansson et al. [ 21 ] provide crowdsourced Bangladeshi Bengali speech, and BanglaBERT [ 22 ] set benchmarks for Bangla language understanding. Bengali speech resources also have a history at O-COCOSDA, from a read-speech corpus for continuous speech recognition [ 23 ] to a prosodically annotated Bengali and Assamese audiobook corpus for sentence boundary detection [ 24 ] . Sentence boundaries in read speech are related to turn ends in conversation but are not the same thing, since a conversational speaker can pause at a sentence boundary and still hold the floor. Turn detection has nothing comparable. There is no public Bangla dataset or benchmark for it, and multilingual models degrade on Bangla because of its prosody and its small share of training data. We built BanglaTurn to fill that gap.
blocks.zh: 与高资源语言相比,孟加拉语的代表性不足。 Mozilla Community Voice [20] and Kjardansson et al. (原始内容存档于2013-03-09). [21]提供众源孟加拉国孟加拉语,孟加拉语BanglaBERT[22]为孟加拉语理解设定了基准. 孟加拉语语音资源在O-COSDA也有历史,从持续语音识别的读音程序(read-speech acture for understanding speech acture)到标注的孟加拉语和阿萨姆语音频程序(英语:Assamese audiobook acture)用于句子边界检测[24]. 阅读语音中的句子边界与对话中的转折相关,但并不相同,因为说话者可以在句子边界上暂停,仍保留着地板. 转弯探测器没有可比性 孟加拉语没有公开的孟加拉语数据集或基准,多语种模型在孟加拉语上由于它的音速和在培训数据中所占的比重很小而退化. 我们建立了孟加拉图尔以填补这一空白。

blocks.en: 3 BanglaTurn Detection Dataset
blocks.zh: 3 BanglaTurn 检测数据集

blocks.en: Conversational Bangla audio is scarce, so we built a pipeline that collects it, separates the speakers, cuts the result into usable segments, and annotates them with model assistance.
blocks.zh: 对话的孟加拉语音频是稀缺的,所以我们建造了一个管道来收集它,把讲音者分开,把结果切成可用的片段,并用模型协助注释它们.

blocks.en: 3.1 Dataset creation
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集的创建

blocks.en: Figure 2 shows the pipeline. The audio comes from Bangla-language conversational podcasts that are publicly viewable on YouTube. We chose podcasts because they are conversational, reasonably clean, and cover a range of topics. Section 8.1 describes the gated terms under which we release this audio. Audio was normalized to \SI 16 \kilo \hertz , 16-bit mono PCM. Speaker boundaries come from PyAnnote Speaker Diarization 3.1 [ 25 ] , which combines voice activity detection, ECAPA-TDNN embeddings [ 26 ] and agglomerative clustering. We merge adjacent segments from the same speaker and discard anything under \SI 2.0 \second . Where the speakers are known in advance, we identify them automatically by verification against reference samples.
blocks.zh: 图2显示管道。 音频来自孟加拉语对话播客, 我们选择播客是因为他们对话, 相当干净, 并涵盖一系列话题。 第8.1节描述了我们发布这段音频的门条。 音频已正常化为\SI 16\kilo\hertz,16位单PCM. 扬声器的边界来自PyAnnot Speakers Diarization 3.1 [25],它结合了语音活动检测,ECAPA-TDNN嵌入[26]和群集. 我们把相邻部分从同一个演讲者中合并起来,然后在\SI 2.0\秒下丢弃任何东西。 在事先知道发言者的地方,我们通过对照参考样本进行核查,自动确定发言者。

blocks.en: Diarization returns segments of arbitrary length, but the model takes a fixed-duration input, so we chunk with Silero VAD under two constraints: each chunk runs \SIrange 3.015.0 \second , with at most \SI 2.0 \second of trailing silence.
blocks.zh: diaration返回任意长度的片段,但模型需要固定的长度输入,所以我们用Silero VAD在两个限制下进行块块:每个块运行\Srange 3.015.0\秒,最多有\SI 2.0\秒的尾声沉默.

blocks.en: 3.2 Label scheme
blocks.zh: 3.2 标签办法

blocks.en: Each sample carries one target label and two auxiliary flags. The target is binary. An endpoint is a clip that ends with a genuine turn completion, where the speaker yields the floor (e.g. “ ami kal bajare giyechilam. ”, “I went to the market yesterday.”). A non-endpoint is a clip after which the same speaker carries on. The model is trained and evaluated on this label alone.
blocks.zh: 每个样本都带有一个目标标签和两个辅助旗帜. 目标为二进制. 结尾点是以真正的转弯完成的剪辑片段,演讲者在片场(例如“ami kal bajare giyechilam.”、“我昨天上市了”。 非终点是片段,之后同一发言者继续发言。 该模型仅在这个标签上经过培训和评估。

blocks.en: The two flags mark hesitation sounds and discourse fillers, such as “ um ” or “ mane ” (“I mean”). They are not classes. Mid-filler marks a filler inside the clip (e.g. “ ami… accha… bhabchilam je amra eta korte pari. ”, “I… well… was thinking that we can do this.”). End-filler marks a filler in the last one to three words (e.g. “ ami kal bajare giyechilam… uh… ”, “I went to the market yesterday… uh…”). The flags are independent of each other and of the target. A speaker can trail off with a filler and then yield the floor, or finish a filler-free sentence and keep going. In the test set, 248 of the 319 clips carry a mid-filler and 104 an end-filler, and both occur with either label. We keep the flags because fillers are where a pause is most easily mistaken for a turn end, and a system that makes that mistake either interrupts the speaker or stalls.
blocks.zh: 两面旗帜标志着犹豫不决的声音和言论充斥,如“um”或“mane”(“我的意思”)。 他们不是班级 中间填充器在弹夹内刻有填充器(例如“ami... acha... bhabchilam je amra eta korte pari.”),“我......好......在想我们能够做到这一点。” 最终填充者在最后1到3个词(例如“ami kal bajare giyechilam...”、“我昨天去了市场......”)中标注了一个填充者。 旗帜相互独立,目标独立. 演讲者可以用填充器后退,然后让出地板,或者完成免填充句,继续前进. 在测试集中,319个片段中有248个带有中装填器,104个带有末装填器,两者都同时带有任何一种标签. 我们保留这些旗帜是因为填充器最容易被误认为是转弯端,而这种系统要么会打断扬声器,要么会停摆。

blocks.en: 3.3 Annotation protocol
blocks.zh: 3.3 注释协议

blocks.en: Labels come from two automatic sources, which a human annotator then reconciled. The first is diarization. The last chunk of a speaker’s turn before a different speaker begins is proposed as an endpoint, and every other chunk as a non-endpoint. This rule is noisy, because diarization errors, overlapping speech and backchannels all create spurious speaker changes. The second is an LLM pass with Google’s Gemini 2.0 Flash Lite, following the LLM-assisted annotation approach of Gilardi et al. [ 27 ] . For each clip, a fixed prompt asks for a Bangla transcription, the two filler flags, and one of four turn states, each defined with examples: Complete (intent fully expressed), Incomplete (a pause inside an unfinished thought), Backchannel (a brief listener response) and Wait (a request to pause or stop). Complete and Wait map to endpoint, Incomplete and Backchannel to non-endpoint, and only the binary label is kept.
blocks.zh: 标签来自两个自动来源,一个人类的注释者随后和解. 第一种是斜化. 在另一发言者开始发言之前,最后一点是作为结束点提出的,其他每一点都是作为非结束点提出的。 这个规则很吵,因为分化错误,重叠的语音和后通道都会产生虚假的扬声器变化. 第二个是Google的双子座2.0 Flash Lite, 每个片段,一个固定的提示请求一个孟加拉语的抄写,两个填充的旗帜,以及四个转弯状态中的一个,每个都用实例定义: 完整(意为完全表达),不完全(在未完成的想法内暂停),后通道(简短的听众回应)和等待(请求暂停或停止). 完成并等待地图到端点,不完全和后通道到非端点,只保留二进制标签.

blocks.en: A single annotator, the author, a native Bangla speaker, then listened to every clip alongside both proposals and the transcription. Where the proposals agreed, the annotator confirmed or corrected the label. Where they disagreed, the annotator decided by listening to the clip alone, without the surrounding audio. Filler flags and transcriptions were checked in the same pass.
blocks.zh: 一名书记员,提交人,一名母语孟加拉语者,然后听了每一段片段以及提案和抄本。 建议书达成一致的,由注释员确认或更正标签. 在他们不同意的情况下,注释员决定只听剪辑,而没有周围的音频。 同一通行证中还检查了填充旗帜和抄本。

blocks.en: This protocol has two gaps. Because one person checked every label, we cannot report inter-annotator agreement. Because corrections were made in place without a log, we cannot report how often the human check changed the automatic labels. Section 7 considers what this means for the results.
blocks.zh: 该议定书有两个漏洞。 因为每个标签都有一个人检查过,所以我们不能报告通知人之间的协议. 因为更正是在没有日志的情况下进行的,所以我们无法报告人类检查频繁地改变自动标签。 第7节考虑这对结果意味着什么。

blocks.en: 3.4 Dataset details
blocks.zh: 3.4 数据集细节

blocks.en: BanglaTurn holds 35,374 samples split into training (31,549), validation (3,506) and test (319) sets, as detailed in Table 1 . Training and validation keep the natural class distribution of roughly 80% endpoints, while the test set is balanced at 49.84% endpoints. The test set is small, but it is not a random in-domain split. It consists of handpicked, class-balanced and deliberately difficult examples taken from a separate podcast that was held out entirely from training and validation. The same annotator who checked the labels selected these examples. The 319 clips run \SIrange [range-phrase= to ,range-units=single]3.015.0 \second and total 51.6 minutes. Because the test set comes from a different speaker and a different distribution, it tests generalization rather than in-domain memorization, which we consider a harder and more informative check than a larger split drawn from the same recordings. Its small size does make every figure uncertain, so we report confidence intervals (Section 5 ).
blocks.zh: BanglaTurn持有35 374个样本,分为培训(31 549个)、验证(3 506个)和测试(319个),详见表1。 训练与验证将自然班级分布约80%的终点,而测试集则平衡为49.84%的终点. 测试集是小的,但不是随机的域内分割. 它包括从一个完全来自培训和验证的单独的播客中挑选出、班级平衡和故意困难的例子。 检查标签的同一位注释员选择了这些示例. 319片段运行\Sirange [距离语=, range-units=single] 3.015.0 秒,总计51.6分钟. 由于测试集来自不同的扬声器和不同的分布,它测试的是泛化而不是域内记忆,我们认为这比从同一录音中抽取的更大分数更难,更丰富的检查. 其规模小确实使每个数字都不确定,因此我们报告信任间隔(第5节)。

blocks.en: 4 Model Architecture
blocks.zh: 4 示范建筑

blocks.en: Our model reuses Whisper’s encoder for binary turn detection, as Figure 1 shows. The task does not call for transcription, only for the acoustic, prosodic and temporal structure of the audio, and the encoder already represents that, so we drop the decoder.
blocks.zh: 如图1所示,我们的模型重新使用Whisper的编码器进行二进制转弯检测。 任务不要求抄写,只要求音频的音响结构,正时结构,编码器已经代表了这一点,所以我们放下解码器.

blocks.en: 4.1 Encoder
blocks.zh: 4.1 编码器

blocks.en: We use a Whisper Tiny encoder fine-tuned on the Mozilla Common Voice 11 Bangla dataset [ 20 ] . Its input is an 80-channel log-Mel spectrogram covering 8 seconds of audio.
blocks.zh: 我们使用Whisper Tiny编码器微调 Mozilla Community Voice 11 Bangla数据集 [20]. 它的输入是一个80通道的log-Mel光谱,涵盖8秒的音频.

blocks.en: 4.2 Multi-scale pooling
blocks.zh: 4.2 多规模集合

blocks.en: Turn detection depends on local acoustic events, such as the final phoneme and the intonation contour, and on the shape of the utterance as a whole. To capture both, we concatenate four pooled views of the encoder output: max pooling for prominent features, mean pooling for the overall representation, attention pooling with a learnable query that can settle on turn-relevant regions, and last-frame pooling for the final temporal state.
blocks.zh: 转动检测取决于局部的声响事件,如最终的电话和进化轮廓,以及整个语音的形状. 为了捕捉两者,我们汇集了编码器输出的四个集合观点:最大集合用于突出特征,意味着集合用于整体代表,注意力集合与可以解决转折相关区域的可学习查询,以及最终时间状态的最后一个框架集合.

blocks.en: 4.3 Classification head
blocks.zh: 4.3 分类头

blocks.en: The head is a stack of linear layers with layer normalization, GELU activations and dropout, ending in a single logit.
blocks.zh: 头部是一叠具有层态的线性层,GELU激活和退出,以单一的对数结束.

blocks.en: 5 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5 实验设置

blocks.en: We compare against Smart-Turn v3 on the same BanglaTurn test split and ablate three variants: the stock Whisper-tiny encoder, trained on 99 languages including Bangla; the same encoder fine-tuned on Bangla; and that Bangla fine-tuned encoder with multi-scale pooling.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了Smart-Turn v3在同一BanglaTurn测试中拆分并放弃了三种变体:股票Whisper-tiny编码器,训练了99种语言,包括Bangla;同一编码器在Bangla上微调;以及孟加拉微调编码器,多尺度集合.

blocks.en: We also compare against two classical baselines that use no learned speech representation. The first is a silence threshold, which predicts an endpoint when the clip’s trailing silence is at least τ \tau seconds. Trailing silence is the time after the last frame within 35 dB of the clip’s peak energy. The second is a logistic regression over trailing silence and four prosodic features of the final 500 ms of speech: F0 slope and F0 level relative to the clip median, both from pYIN [ 28 ] , energy slope, and the duration of the final speech segment, plus an indicator for clips with no final pitch estimate. We fit both on the test podcast itself by stratified 10-fold cross-validation, choosing τ \tau or the regression weights on nine folds and predicting the tenth. The baselines thereby see the test speaker and recording conditions, which the neural models never do, so their scores are optimistic.
blocks.zh: 我们还比较了两个古典的基线,这两个基线没有使用学到的演讲表述。 第一个是沉默阈值,它预言片段的尾声至少是\tau秒时的终点。 沉寂是片段的顶峰能量35 dB的最后一帧之后的时间。 二是尾声沉寂后的后勤回归和最后500ms语音的4个偏差特征:F0坡度和F0平度相对于剪辑中位数,均来自pYIN [28],能量坡度,以及最后语音段的持续时间,外加一个没有最终投注估计的剪辑指标. 通过分级10倍的交叉验证 选择\ tau 或九叠的回归权重 并预测第十倍 基线由此可见测试扬声器和录制条件,神经模型从来没有这样做,所以他们的分数是乐观的.

blocks.en: Training uses Binary Cross-Entropy (logits) loss with dynamic class weighting, which keeps the model from collapsing onto the majority class. We use AdamW [ 29 ] at learning rate 5e-5, weight decay 0.01 and gradient clipping at 1.0, for 4 epochs at batch size 16, with a 0.2 linear warmup ratio and cosine decay, on a single NVIDIA A40 ( \SI 48 \giga \byte ).
blocks.zh: 训练使用二进制交叉输入(logits)减值,并进行动态班次加权,这可以防止模型倒塌到多数班级. 我们使用 AdamW [29] 的学习速率 5e-5,重量衰减 0.01 和梯度剪切 1.0, 对于 4 个纪元, 批量大小 16, 具有 0.2 线性暖和率和 余弦衰减, 在单个 NVIDIA A40 (\SI 48\giga\byte )上。

blocks.en: Two error rates matter most here. A false positive, predicting an endpoint while the speaker is still mid-turn, makes the system interrupt. A false negative makes it wait when it should respond. With endpoint as the positive class and a decision threshold of 0.5, we report the false positive rate FPR = FP / ( FP + TN ) =\mathrm{FP}/(\mathrm{FP}+\mathrm{TN}) and the false negative rate FNR = FN / ( FN + TP ) =\mathrm{FN}/(\mathrm{FN}+\mathrm{TP}) alongside accuracy, precision, recall and F1, together with inference latency and model size. Because the test set is small, we attach 95% percentile bootstrap confidence intervals to accuracy and F1, computed from 10,000 resamples of the 319 test clips.
blocks.zh: 这里有两个错误率最重要 假阳性,预测一个终点,而扬声器仍然在中转,使得系统中断. 虚假的负面反应会让它等待何时做出回应. 端点为正分级,决定阈值为0.5,我们报告FPR = FP / (FP + TN ) → mathrm{FP}/(\mathrm{FP}+\ + mathrm{TN}) 和 FNR = FN /(FN + TP ) → mathrm{FN}/(\mathrm{FN}+\ + mathrm{TP}) 的假正分率,以及精度,召回度和F1, 以及推论纬度和模型大小. 由于测试装置很小,我们把95%的靴子置信间隔加在精度和F1上,从319个测试片段的10,000个复标计算。

blocks.en: 6 Results and Analysis
blocks.zh: 6 结果和分析

blocks.en: 6.1 Overall performance comparison
blocks.zh: 6.1 国家 总体业绩比较

blocks.en: Our model reaches 84.33% accuracy where Smart-Turn v3 reaches 69.28% (Table 2 ). The confidence intervals do not overlap. An unpaired two-proportion test on accuracy, which is conservative for two models scored on the same clips, gives z = 4.50 z=4.50 , p < 10 − 5 p<10^{-5} . The baseline is precise, at 82.80%, but it misses a great deal, at 48.43% recall. Ours is more balanced, at 79.46% precision and 92.45% recall. Table 4 gives the underlying counts. The clearest difference is in missed endpoints, which fall from 82 to 12, a false negative rate of 51.57% against 7.55% and close to a sevenfold reduction. We pay for that with more false positives, 38 against 16, an FPR of 23.75% against 10.00%. F1 rises from 61.11% to 85.47%.
blocks.zh: 我们的模型达到84.33%的准确度,Smart-Turn v3达到69.28%(表2)。 信心间隔并不重叠。 对精度进行未保值的双比例测试,对于在同一片段上得分的两个模型来说是保守的,给出z = 4.50 z = 4.50,p < 10 - 5 p < 10^{-5}. 基准是准确的,为82.80%,但漏掉了很多,为48.43%。 我们的平衡性更强,精确度为79.46%,召回率为92.45%. 表4列出了基本数字。 最明显的区别在于错失终点,从82落到12,假负率为51.57%,对7.55%,接近7倍的下降. 我们为此付出更多虚假的阳性,38对16,23.75%的FPR对10.00%. F1从61.11%上升到85.47%.

blocks.en: Neither classical baseline comes close, even though both were fitted on the test podcast. The silence threshold scores 49.22%, no better than chance. The prosody and silence regression reaches 62.07%, and nearly all of that comes from trailing silence. Fitted on silence alone, the same regression reaches 63.32%, and on the prosodic features alone, 50.78%. Section 7 explains why silence behaves this way on BanglaTurn.
blocks.zh: 无论是古典基准都接近,尽管两者都安装在测试播客上。 沉默门槛得分49.22%,没有比机会更好的. 顺理成章和寂静回归率达到62.07%,几乎所有这一切都来自于紧随其后的寂静. 仅靠沉默,同样的回归率就达到了63.32%,仅靠偏僻特征就达到了50.78%。 第7节解释了为什么沉默在孟加拉岛是这样表现的。

blocks.en: 6.2 Ablation study
blocks.zh: 6.2 读取研究

blocks.en: Table 3 separates three factors: the encoder, generic or Bangla fine-tuned; the addition of Multi-Scale Pooling (MSP); and the number of unfrozen encoder layers.
blocks.zh: 表3将三个因素分开:编码器、通用编码器或孟加拉式微调;多比例聚合(MSP);解冻编码层的数目。

blocks.en: With the encoder frozen, the Bangla fine-tuned version edges out the generic one, 84.68 against 83.83 F1. MSP helps once encoder layers are unfrozen, most at 2 unfrozen layers (85.47 against 82.66 F1) and less at 4 (84.75 against 83.29). With a frozen encoder it is slightly worse (84.21 against 84.68). Unfreezing 4 layers with MSP gives the lowest FNR in the table, 5.66%, but costs precision, 76.92% against 79.46% at 2 layers, which suggests the extra capacity starts fitting the training podcasts rather than the task. We settled on the Bangla fine-tuned encoder with MSP and 2 unfrozen layers, at 84.33% accuracy and 85.47 F1.
blocks.zh: 随着编码器的冷冻,孟加拉微调版的边缘从通用的1,84.68对83.83 F1. MSP帮助在编码器层解冻后进行解冻,大多数在2个解冻层(85.47对82.66 F1),在4个解冻层(84.75对83.29)时减少. 使用冷冻编码器,情况稍差(84.21对84.68)。 与MSP一起解冻4层给出了表中最低的FNR,5.66%,但成本精确度为76.92%,而2层为79.46%,这表明额外的容量开始安装培训播客而不是任务. 我们用MSP和2个解冻层的孟加拉微调编码器定居,精确度为84.33%和85.47 F1.

blocks.en: These differences should be read with care. The accuracy intervals span about ± \pm 4 points, and no two rows differ by more than 3.14 points, so the ablation suggests an ordering of configurations but does not establish that any one is better than another.
blocks.zh: 应仔细阅读这些差异。 精度间隔跨度约为±\pm 4分,无两行差异大于3.14分,因此衰减暗示了配置的顺序,但没有确定任何一行比另一行更好.

blocks.en: 6.3 Quantization analysis
blocks.zh: 6.3 量化分析

blocks.en: INT8 dynamic quantization shrinks the model by roughly 73%, from 148–149 MB to 39–40 MB [ 30 , 31 ] , and cuts end-to-end latency by 6–13%, from \SIrange [range-phrase=–,range-units=single]180191 \milli \second to \SIrange [range-phrase=–,range-units=single]165170 \milli \second . Table 5 gives the figures per configuration. Accuracy mostly survives quantization. The final model loses 1.26 points and the generic encoder 0.31, but the Bangla fine-tuned encoder without MSP loses 4.70 points, from 84.01% to 79.31%.
blocks.zh: INT8动态量子化将模型缩小了约73%,从148–149 MB到39–40 MB [30, 31],将端到端的耐性削减了6–13%,从\Srange [range-ext-units=single]180191\mili\秒到\Srange [range-exits=single]165170\mili\秒. 表5列出了每个配置的数字。 准确性大多在量化后存活。 最终型号损失1.26分,通用编码器损失0.31分,但没有MSP的孟加拉微调编码器损失4.70分,从84.01%降至79.31%.

blocks.en: 7 Discussion
blocks.zh: 7 讨论情况

blocks.en: 7.1 Error trade-off and operating point
blocks.zh: 7.1 差错权衡与操作点

blocks.en: The two models fail in opposite directions. Smart-Turn v3 predicts an endpoint for only 93 of the 319 clips and misses 82 of the 159 real ones, so a voice agent built on it would often leave the user waiting in silence. Our model makes the opposite error. At the 0.5 threshold it declares an endpoint on 38 of the 160 clips where the speaker would have carried on, so it would cut in on roughly one such pause in four. Neither balance suits every application. A fast-responding assistant can tolerate an occasional interruption, while cutting the speaker off is costly in dictation or counselling. Because our model outputs a probability, the threshold can be raised to trade missed endpoints for fewer interruptions, or the prediction can be combined with a short silence timeout before the system takes the turn. We report only the 0.5 operating point here, and choosing a threshold on held-out data for a given application is left to future work.
blocks.zh: 两种模式在相反方向都失败. Smart-Turn v3预言319片断中只有93片结束点,并错过了159片真实片断中的82片,因此在其上搭建的语音代理经常让用户静默等待. 我们的模型犯了相反的错误。 在0.5的门槛上,它宣布在160个片段中的38个片段有一个终点,发言者可以继续发言,因此,它将在大约4个片段中减少一个片段。 两者都不适合每个申请。 快速响应的助手可以容忍偶尔的中断,而截断扬声器则在口述或咨询上代价高昂. 因为我们的模型输出出一种概率,阈值可以被提升到交易中错失的终点,以减少中断,或者在系统转向之前,预测可以与短暂的静态超时相结合. 我们只报告这里的0.5操作点,为某个应用程序选择一个被搁置数据的阈值留给今后的工作。

blocks.en: Deployment also calls for checking accuracy after quantization model by model. INT8 costs the final model 1.26 points but costs the Bangla fine-tuned encoder without MSP 4.70 points (Table 5 ). We have not isolated the cause of that difference.
blocks.zh: 部署工作还要求在按模型进行量化后检查准确性。 INT8成本为最终型号1.26分,但成本为孟加拉微调编码器,没有MSP4.70分(表5). 我们没有孤立造成这种分歧的原因。

blocks.en: 7.2 What silence does and does not tell us
blocks.zh: 第7.2条 默默无声的告诉我们

blocks.en: On BanglaTurn, trailing silence points the wrong way. Endpoint clips end with a median of 0.001 s of silence against 0.051 s for non-endpoint clips. That is why a conventional silence threshold scores at chance, while a regression free to learn the reversed direction reaches 63.32%. The cause is how clips are cut. An endpoint clip ends where diarization detects the next speaker, leaving little silence, while a non-endpoint clip ends at a pause that voice activity detection found inside a turn. This is an artefact of corpus construction, not a property of Bangla turn-taking, and it has two consequences. First, silence duration, the cue deployed systems rely on most, cannot solve the task here, so the benchmark tests other cues. Second, a learned model could use the reversed cue as a shortcut. Our model’s 84.33% is far above the 63.32% that silence alone reaches, so the shortcut cannot account for its performance, but it may account for part of it. Balancing trailing silence across the two classes in a future release would remove that doubt.
blocks.zh: 在孟加拉, 端点片段以0.001 s的中位数结束,对于非端点片段,则以0.051 s的中位数结束. 这就是为什么传统的沉默门槛值偶然得分,而自由学习反向方向的回归则达到63.32%。 原因是剪辑是如何剪切的. 端点剪辑结束于对接下一位扬声器的检测,留下一点沉默,而非端点剪辑结束于一个在转弯内发现的声音活动检测的暂停. 这是一种造物术,不是孟加拉人取走的财产,它有两个后果。 首先,沉默持续时间,提示部署的系统大多依赖,无法在此解决任务,因此基准测试其他提示. 第二,一个学习的模型可以使用反向提示作为捷径. 我们模式的84.33%远远高于仅沉默就达到的63.32%,因此捷径不能说明其性能,但可能占部分。 在未来释放时平衡两班人的沉默将会消除这种疑虑。

blocks.en: The prosodic features were even less useful on their own, at 50.78%. The final pitch slope does fall more steeply before endpoints, consistent with the final lowering reported by Ishimoto and Enomoto [ 16 ] and by Ward and Vega [ 14 ] , but on these short, filler-heavy clips the effect is too weak for a linear model to use. Whatever our model has learned, it is not captured by a handful of utterance-final prosodic measurements.
blocks.zh: Prosodition的特征本身更无用,为50.78%. 最后的投球斜坡的确在终点之前更陡峭地落下,这与石本和江野本[16]以及沃德和维加[14]报告的最后下降一致,但是在这些短的,填充重的夹片上,效果太弱,线性模型无法使用. 不管我们的模型学到了什么,它并没有被少数的言论-最终的断层测量所捕捉。

blocks.en: 7.3 Uncertainty and label quality
blocks.zh: 7.3 不确定性和标签质量

blocks.en: With 319 test clips, every figure carries real uncertainty. The gap to Smart-Turn v3 is large enough to survive it, but most ablation differences are not, and ranking the configurations with confidence would need a larger held-out set covering more podcasts. Label quality adds uncertainty that the intervals do not capture. A single annotator checked every label and also selected the test clips, so there is no agreement figure to bound the label error rate and no independent check on the selection. Where a clip’s turn state is genuinely ambiguous, the reference label reflects one person’s judgement, and the measured accuracy is partly agreement with that judgement.
blocks.zh: 有319个测试片段,每个数字都带有真正的不确定性. 与Smart-Turn v3的间隙足够大,可以生存下来,但大多数的衰减差异并不大,自信地排列配置需要更大的悬浮集,覆盖更多的播客. 标签质量增加了间隔不捕捉的不确定性. 单个注释员检查了每个标签,也选择了测试片段,所以没有约定数字来约束标签错误率,也没有独立检查选择. 如果片段的转弯状态确实模棱两可,那么参考标签就反映了一个人的判断,所测量的准确性部分与该判断一致。

blocks.en: 7.4 Beyond podcasts
blocks.zh: 7.4 (中文(简体) ). 超越播客

blocks.en: All of BanglaTurn is podcast speech, and the 84.33% figure should not be expected to carry over unchanged to the settings where turn detection matters most commercially. Phone calls are narrowband, typically sampled at 8 kHz and passed through lossy codecs, which strips much of the spectral detail that a Whisper encoder trained on wideband audio relies on. Voice-assistant interactions are dominated by short commands and questions, whose prosody and pausing differ from the long, planned turns of a podcast conversation. Both settings also bring background noise and overlapping speech that edited podcasts largely avoid. We expect accuracy to drop in each of them, and Bangla test sets built from telephone and assistant speech are the most direct next step.
blocks.zh: 所有孟加拉土邦都是播客的演说,84.33%的数字不应被预期会一直延续到那些在商业上最能检测转弯的场合。 电话调用是窄带,典型的采样为8千赫,并经过失落的解码器,这剥离了Whisper编码器在宽带音频上训练的大部分光谱细节. 语音辅助互动以短指令和问题为主,其流畅和乏味与播客对话的长期、有计划的回合不同。 这两个设置还带来背景噪声和重叠的语音,编辑播客基本上避免. 我们期望每集的精度下降,通过电话和助理语音制作的孟加拉测试机是下一步最直接的步骤。

blocks.en: 8 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: We have described the first Bangla turn detection dataset, 35,374 samples built with a pipeline that transfers to other languages, and a Whisper encoder-based model that reaches 84.33% accuracy, 15.05 points above the baseline in absolute terms and 21.7% in relative terms. INT8 quantization compresses that model by 73% and cuts its latency by 13% at a cost of 1.26 accuracy points. We hope the corpus and the pipeline together give other low-resource languages a place to start.
blocks.zh: 我们描述了第一个孟加拉回合检测数据集,35 374个样本用一条输往其他语言的管道建造,以及一个Whisper编码器模型,其精度达到84.33%,绝对值高于基线15.05点,相对值为21.7%。 INT8量化压缩了该模型的73%,并以1.26的精度点成本将它的耐久性削减了13%. 我们希望,教程和管道共同为其他低资源语言提供起点。

blocks.en: 8.1 Ethical considerations
blocks.zh: 8.1 道德考虑

blocks.en: We release BanglaTurn through gated access by choice. The audio comes from podcasts that are publicly viewable on YouTube, and although that makes the recordings easy to obtain, we treat them as the work of the people who made them rather than as free material, and we did not seek redistribution permission from individual rights holders. Access is therefore granted on request, for research use only. We release clips of 3 to 15 seconds rather than full episodes, without speaker names or links from clips to their source episodes. Voices are nonetheless identifying and the source recordings remain public, so we do not claim the data is anonymous. Any rights holder or speaker can have their material removed from the dataset by contacting the author at the address on the first page.
blocks.zh: 我们通过有门的通道 选择释放孟加拉人 音频来自在YouTube上可公开观看的播客,虽然这使得录音容易获得,但我们把他们当作制作这些录音的人的作品而不是免费的材料,我们没有寻求个别权利持有者的再分配许可. 因此,只有在请求时才允许进入,仅供研究使用。 我们发布3至15秒的片段,而不是完整片段,没有扬声器名,也没有从片段到源片段的链接. 但声音正在辨认,来源录音仍然公开,因此我们并不声称数据是匿名的。 任何权利持有人或发言人都可以通过在第一页的地址与作者联系,将其材料从数据集中删除。

blocks.en: 8.2 Limitations
blocks.zh: 8.2 限制

blocks.en: The dataset covers one domain and one register. Podcast conversation is not phone speech, a voice-assistant exchange, a multi-party meeting or a human-robot exchange, so we cannot claim the model carries over to those settings. The labels rest on a single annotator’s check of automatic proposals, with no inter-annotator agreement and no record of how many labels the check changed, so the label error rate is unknown. The same annotator selected the 319 test clips, so the test set is small and its difficulty reflects one person’s judgement. Trailing silence differs systematically between endpoint and non-endpoint clips because of how the clips are cut, and a model may exploit it. All error rates are reported at a single decision threshold. The model itself sees a fixed 8-second window, which rules out longer-range discourse cues, works from audio alone, and inherits whatever prosodic information Whisper’s features happen to encode.
blocks.zh: 数据集涵盖一个域和一个登记册. Podcast对话不是电话演讲、语音辅助交流、多党会议或人机器人交流, 标签依赖于单一的注释员对自动提案的检查,没有通知员之间的协议,也没有记录多少标签更改,因此标签错误率不明. 同一名注释员选择了319个测试片段,因此测试片段很小,其难度反映了一个人的判断. 拖曳的沉默在端点与非端点的夹片之间有系统性的差异,因为夹片是如何切的,一个模型可能会利用它. 所有误差率均按单一决定阈值报告。 模式本身看到了一个固定的8秒窗口,它排除了更远的语句提示,从音频单独工作,继承了Whisper的特性恰好编码的任意prosotic信息.

blocks.en: 9 Generative AI Use Disclosure
blocks.zh: 9 基因AI 使用披露

blocks.en: Generative AI was used in two ways. As part of the method, Google’s Gemini 2.0 Flash Lite produced first-pass transcriptions and turn-state annotations for the BanglaTurn corpus, as described in Section 3.3 ; the author checked every resulting label by hand. Separately, generative AI assistance was used to edit and polish the wording of this manuscript. It did not produce a significant part of the manuscript, and the author takes full responsibility for the content of the paper.
blocks.zh: 基因AI有两种使用方式. 作为方法的一部分,Google的双子座2.0 Flash Lite为BanglaTurne程序制作了第一通道的抄本和转写说明,如第3.3节所述;作者用手检查了所有产生的标签。 另外,还利用基因AI协助来编辑和擦亮这本手稿的措辞. 它没有拿出相当一部分手稿,作者对论文的内容承担全部责任.
